items.source: the built response
Variant of body(Publisher, Class) that allows using any producer that can be resolved to Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: `body(Publisher, Class)` 的变体，允许使用任何可通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 解析为 Publisher 的生产者。

items.source: Set the body of the response to the given Object and return it. This is a shortcut for using a body(BodyInserter) with a value inserter.
items.translation: 将响应体设置为给定的 `Object` 并返回它。这是使用带有 值插入器 的 body(BodyInserter) 的快捷方式。

items.source: Add a serialization hint like JacksonCodecSupport.JSON_VIEW_HINT to customize how the body will be serialized.
items.translation: 添加一个序列化提示，例如JacksonCodecSupport.JSON_VIEW_HINT，以自定义如何序列化正文。

items.source: body - the body of the response
name - the name of the template to be rendered
this builder
Note: Empty Collections are not added to the model when using this method because we cannot correctly determine the true convention name.
items.translation: 注意：使用此方法时，空的Collections不会添加到模型中，因为我们无法正确确定其真正的约定名称。

items.source: Variant of body(Publisher, ParameterizedTypeReference) that allows using any producer that can be resolved to Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: `body(Publisher, ParameterizedTypeReference)` 的变体，允许使用任何可通过 `ReactiveAdapterRegistry` 解析为 Publisher 的生产者。

items.source: Set the body from the given Publisher. Shortcut for body(BodyInserter) with a Publisher inserter.
items.translation: 从给定的 Publisher 设置 body。这是带有 Publisher 插入器 的 body(BodyInserter) 的快捷方式。

items.source: Set the media type of the body, as specified by the Content-Type header.
items.translation: 设置正文的媒体类型，由`Content-Type` 标头指定。

items.source: Render the template with the given name using the given model.
Set the body of the response to the given BodyInserter and return it.
items.translation: 将响应体设置为给定的 `BodyInserter` 并返回它。

items.source: Set the body of the response to the given Object and return it.
items.translation: 将响应的主体设置为给定的Object并返回它。

items.source: Set the length of the body in bytes, as specified by the Content-Length header.
items.translation: 设置以 Content-Length 标头指定的字节数作为正文长度。

items.source: Customize the serialization hints with the given consumer.
items.translation: 使用给定的 Consumer 自定义序列化提示。
